verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the body copy is blown up to nearly headline size, so it competes with the headline. The divider is jammed against 'Evenings' and the body text, the sun icon is lost from the header, the CTA is tiny next to the oversized copy, and the legal text is crammed at the bottom edge. B keeps the original hierarchy, the centred axis and the logo, but it is essentially a straight shrink: the body copy, the CTA label, 'Ships late June' and the legal text are all too small to read at 300x250, and the lower half is loosely spaced.
